variants.headline: Party names a new leader
variants.sub: Leadership of {party} has changed, with {new} the new leader.
variants.body:
The party {party} has a new leader: {new}. A change at the head of an organisation is a political fact; a change in its programme is a separate question. Readers considering {target} should not have to accept the second as a necessary consequence of the first.

Labour has reason to pay attention to a new party leader, without assuming that a different face means a different life for workers. Wages, safety and household needs remain the useful yardstick. A political organisation should be judged by how seriously it takes those matters, whoever speaks for it.

We welcome {target} in this assessment. New leadership deserves the opportunity for a fair hearing, and recognition of that opportunity need not depend on inventing achievements before they occur. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.
